Text pulled in with `.. include::` now goes through the `source-read` event, so replacements like `&REPLACE_ME;` → `REPLACED` show up in the final HTML. The new test fails without the fix and passes with it. Nothing is committed.

**Why it happened:** Sphinx emits `source-read` only when it reads a document. The include directive reads the included file itself and feeds the lines straight into the parser, so the event never reached that text. Your handler did run for `something-to-include.rst`, but only when Sphinx read that file as its own page. The copy inside `index.rst` was the raw text from disk.

**The fix** (in `Include.run()`, `sphinx/directives/other.py`):
- Before the directive runs, it swaps in a wrapper for the step that feeds included lines to the parser.
- The wrapper joins the included lines into one string and emits `source-read` with that file's document name (or `None` if the file isn't a document). It then splits the result back into lines.
- docutils adds two marker lines to the end of included content. The wrapper leaves them out of the event and puts them back afterwards. I confirmed docutils 0.20.1 adds exactly these two lines.
- The wrapper is only installed when some extension has a `source-read` handler. Otherwise nothing changes.

A file that is both its own page and included elsewhere gets the event once for each.

**Tests:**
- New test `test_include_source_read_event` in `tests/test_directive_other.py`, with a test project in `tests/roots/test-directive-include/`. It builds a page that includes another file and checks the handler's replacement appears in `index.html`.
- I fixed one assertion in it. It checked that `&REPLACE_ME;` was absent, but HTML writes `&` as `&`, so that check could never fail. It now checks for `REPLACE_ME`.
- Running `test_directive_other`, `test_directive_code`, `test_util_rst` and `test_events`: 60 passed, 2 failed. The failures are `test_literal_include_linenos` and `test_linenothreshold`, and they fail the same way with my change removed.
- The worker ran `tests/test_build_html.py`: 538 passed, 1 failed (`test_html_code_role`), which also fails without the change. I didn't rerun that file myself.
- Ruff isn't installed in the venv, so the new code hasn't been linted.

I also added a line to `CHANGES` under "Bugs fixed", referencing #10678.
